headline: A 2018 law lets the Pacific Historic Parks set up a commemorative display honoring those who served in the Pacific during World War II.
what_it_does: The law allows the Pacific Historic Parks to create and maintain a display honoring U.S. Armed Forces members and Allied personnel who served in the Pacific Theater in World War II. Federal money cannot be used to design, build, install, or maintain the display. The National Park Service may accept and spend nonfederal donations of money and resources for it.
when_it_takes_effect: The summary gives no separate effective date, so the law took effect when it was enacted on May 7, 2018.
